title: Monotonicity of guarded halting
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with oracle, let $x$ be an input, let $G$ and $G'$ be predicates on configurations, and let $a$ be an initial configuration. If the run from $a$ halts with answer $r$ and every configuration before halting satisfies $G$, and every configuration satisfying $G$ also satisfies $G'$, then the run from $a$ halts with answer $r$ and every configuration before halting satisfies $G'.$
